text: Worker-1 round 3 (released per timebox): the producer infrastructure is LANDED on beads-worker-1 - (1) Cargo feature 'root-sig'; (2) root_sig.rs pub(crate) produce_root_dio_signature_option(signer, signer_iid, dodag_id, instance, version, rank, expiry, root_seq, mop) building the canonical payload (labels 1-7), protected {1:-65537}, Sig_structure, Schnorr48 over SHA-256 (signer injected as &dyn Fn(&[u8])->[u8;48] so the link key is used without root_sig knowing LinkLayer), COSE_Tag(18) wrap + 0x17 option frame; (3) Router field root_dio_seq (starts 1, terminal u64::MAX) + build_authenticated_dio_with_root_sig(&mut, out, link, expiry) appending the option; (4) send_dio (transmit.rs) feature-gated emission: root + valid wall clock -> expiry = clock()+ROOT_SIG_TTL_SECONDS(300) -> signed build; no clock/leaf -> unsigned (Baseline downstream). Body buffer 160->512. Commits: c8205aa6e1 (sync-swept producer+router+field), 3662afcc2e (buffer + TTL const + send_dio wiring partial). REMAINING for the next worker: the round-trip test (ignored in tests.rs, root_dio_signature_roundtrip_produces_and_advances) still hits TxError::BufferTooSmall in send_dio DESPITE the 512-byte body - the failing write is NOT the 0x17 append (producer probes showed the option builds) - instrument build_authenticated_dio's internal writes (dio.write_to / dodag_config.write_to / version-auth write_to) with the 512 budget to find which returns 0/BufferTooSmall; fix, un-ignore, and the round-trip closes .2. Verify with cargo test -p lichen-node --features std,root-sig --lib root_dio_signature_roundtrip.
